div.div: قَبْصَةٌ What one takes with the ends of his fingers; as also ↓ قُبْصَةٌ , (K,) and ↓ قَبِيصَةٌ : (S, Msb:) [in the L, قُبَيْصَةٌ; but this is the dim. of the first and second of the above words:] or, accord. to some, the first is a noun signifying the act [of so taking]: (M:) and the second, (M,) or this and the first also, (K,) signifies what one's two hands carry, of food, or wheat: (M, K:) the pl. of ↓ قُبْصَةٌ is قُبَصٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
